name: Captain N. Katya
source:
Katya's family is the leader of the central government's offices on the planet of Hoshi.

She requested a transfer to the special air unit to dodge her political responsibilities. She takes pleasure in fueling the drama between Captian Ailith and Corporal Fubuki.
